sections.label: COMPASS for Employment Pass applications
sections.summary: From September 2023, the Complementarity Assessment Framework will be rolled out for new Employment Pass applications.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: From September 2023, we will roll out the Complementarity Assessment Framework (COMPASS) for new Employment Pass (EP) applications.

sections.label: Progressive Wages for lower-wage workers
sections.summary: By July 2023, up to nine in ten lower-wage workers will benefit from Progressive Wages.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: By July 2023, up to nine in ten lower-wage workers will benefit from Progressive Wages (PWs).

sections.label: Platform workers injury compensation and CPF
sections.summary: Platform companies will be required to provide platform workers with work injury compensation and CPF contributions.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: A substantial group of workers provide services, such as deliveries and vehicle rides, via digital platforms.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: We have accepted the recommendations of the Advisory Committee on Platform Workers and will require platform companies to provide platform workers with work injury compensation and Central Provident Fund (CPF) contributions.

sections.label: CPF monthly salary ceiling raise
sections.summary: The CPF monthly salary ceiling will be raised to keep pace with rising incomes, helping middle-income workers save more.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: We will bolster retirement adequacy and make sure the CPF system continues to work for the broad majority of Singaporeans.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: We will raise the CPF monthly salary ceiling to keep pace with rising incomes, which will help middle-income workers save more during their working years.

sections.label: Fair hiring, workplace fairness and safety
sections.summary: Employers must advertise jobs on MyCareersFuture and fairly consider candidates; workplace fairness legislation, FWA guidelines and a 2028 safety target are set.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: Employers must pay attention to fair consideration when hiring.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: We will require employers, by law, to advertise jobs on MyCareersFuture and fairly consider all candidates, before applying for an EP or S Pass.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: We will enact workplace fairness legislation to provide stronger protection against workplace discrimination and enable workers to seek redress for harm done.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: By 2024, we will introduce Tripartite Guidelines on Flexible Work Arrangements (FWAs) to help employers and employees adopt FWAs in a win-win manner.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: Even one workplace death is one too many.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: We remain committed to advancing workplace safety and health, and will strive towards our 2028 target to reduce the workplace fatal injury rate to below 1.0 per 100,000 workers.
